notes.title: V3.1.0 Update: Added 'Zettai Meirei☆UPUP!?' by VTuber 'NekomaShiroa'
notes.notes:
We are the circle "Honwaka Fuwafuwa."

"Real-Time Assist Replay Time　～1 minute until closing～"
We have updated to Version 3.1.0.

The details are as follows:

■ Update Contents

・New Song Added
[previewyoutube=cLla1XFG3nw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
We added "Zettai Meirei☆UPUP!? / NekomaShiroa." It can be set from the BGM settings on the left side of the screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43729605/a01d984bce940f5399e5af09df4f7804830048d3.png
・Pause Menu can be displayed by pressing Enter during Normal Mode and 777 Mode play.

You can also navigate from the pause menu using keyboard controls. This should enhance the game's retry functionality.

・Added checkboxes next to each end card thumbnail on the end card screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43729605/a5bce29f06e7fb889b086114b46439ef9dd6414a.png
By default, all end card checkboxes are selected. If you uncheck them, the end cards will no longer appear in the result screen during Normal Mode, 777 Mode, and Endless Mode play. This allows you to increase the appearance rate of your favorite end card. If all are turned off, the behavior is the same as if all are turned on.

Thank you.
We appreciate your continued support of "Real-time Assist Replay Time One Minute Until Closing."
